# Blend template + Editor Add-on

Target file: `blend/UPVN_Template.blend`
Editor add-on: `blend/upvn_editor_addon.py` (minimal coding tools, v0.6 self-contained)
Installable release: `dist/upvn_editor_addon_v0.6.0.zip` (engine bundled — see `tools/package_addon.py`)

## Scene layout (as generated by build_vn_scene / tools/make_template.py)

```
Scene: VN_Main
  Camera_UI (Ortho, size 10)
  Camera_3D (Perspective)
  Empty: VNController  (props: script_path, upvn_root, upvn_bricks;
                        logic: Always True pulse → Python controller)
  Collection: VN_Backgrounds  (plane “BG_Plane” at z=0)
  Collection: VN_Characters   (planes “Sprite_left/center/right” at z=1)
  Collection: VN_UI           (plane “Dialogue_Box” + Text objects)
  Collection: VN_Effects      (for fade/dissolve shader planes)
  Collection: VN_3DStage      (empty markers: marker_eileen etc., 3D classroom mesh)
  Text datablock: upvn_launcher   (path-bootstrap; imported by the Python brick)
```

## Wiring (v0.6 — done for you, idempotent)

- In the UPBGE UI press **Setup Scene** in the UPVN tab once. It creates/refreshes
  everything above via `blend.upvn_editor_addon.build_vn_scene()` (pure data API) and
  adds the brick with the official `bpy.ops.logic.*` calls UPBGE's own add-ons use:
  `Always (True pulse) → Python(upvn_launcher text) → bge_frontend.frontend.main(cont)`.
- `frontend.main` reads **`script_path` from the `VNController` object** — the same
  property the UPVN panel writes (`project_path`) — so the built game is the game that
  plays. It then ticks `VNController` each frame and handles click/space.
- `blf` overlay draws typewriter text; or `Text` objects (`Dialogue_Text`) — both supported.
- In `--background` runs the brick operators are skipped on purpose (they need an
  interactive context in UPBGE 0.50) — the console says so, and the panel button does it
  in one click in the UI.

## Editor add-on (minimal coding)

Install in Blender/UPBGE — preferred: the zip release
```
Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install from Disk… (or Install…) →
select dist/upvn_editor_addon_v0.6.0.zip → Enable "UPVN — Visual Novel Editor"
```
or from the repo: install `blend/upvn_editor_addon.py` (engine discovery also finds the
repo root next to it).
Then `View3D > Sidebar (N) > UPVN` and `Text Editor > Sidebar > UPVN` show panels:

- **Project**: `Create UPVN Project` → `//game/script.rpy` starter
- **Characters**: ID / Name / Color → `Add Character` → `define`
- **Scene & Sprites**: BG name → `Add Scene`; asset/position/with → `Add Show`
- **Dialogue**: speaker + text → `Add Dialogue` (supports `[var]` and `{b}/{color}`)
- **Menu**: caption + 2 choices/jumps → `Add Menu`
- **Tools**: `Validate` (parser line/col + hint), `Preview` (headless screenshot), `Save Demo (arbitrary slot)` → demos `SaveManager.save(999)` etc., saves are **arbitrary 1..∞** with pagination (6 per page, ←→)

Headless fallback: `tools/upvn_game_creator.py` uses same `UPVN_GameBuilder` API without `bpy`:
```bash
python tools/upvn_game_creator.py
# quick_game(project="my_game", characters=[("e","Eileen","#c8ffc8")], dialogues=[("e","Hi")])
```

## Generation

`tools/make_template.py` is data-API-only (no `bpy.ops` context traps) and reuses the
add-on's `build_vn_scene()` so the generated file matches the panel's Setup Scene.

```bash
upbge-0.50-linux-x64/blender --background --python tools/make_template.py
```

Background runs create the full scene + launcher text but **skip the logic-brick
operators** (UPBGE 0.50's `bpy.ops.logic.*` needs an interactive context). After opening
the generated blend in the UPBGE UI, press **Setup Scene** in the UPVN tab once and
File → Save — that wires and persists the Always → Python brick. (Do not hand-wire
sensors/controllers: the operator is idempotent and much harder to get wrong.)

See also `engine/render/*` for how `scene`/`show` events map to plane textures (`bge.texture`). Arbitrary saves: `engine/save/save_manager.py` (`list_slot_ids`, `next_available_slot`, `slot_exists`) and `engine/ui/screen_manager.py` (pagination, any int slot).
